speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui
text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) what are the contingency measures to ensure that the rest of an MRT line's network still operates when there are service disruptions at other parts of the line; (b) whether the driverless nature of underground lines hamper the detection of abnormalities along tracks, such as the presence of debris and arcing and what are the measures to circumvent this limitation; (c) whether pump systems are installed along the underground network where flooding is generally thought to be less likely; and (d) what age-reliability issues are our trains and stations facing.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: Staff also patrol the tunnels regularly to conduct visual checks.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: I am sure we will talk a lot more about this shortly.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We have, therefore, embarked on a multi-year programme to replace all the key components, including the power supply, the signalling system, track circuits and trains.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: We will also be carrying out extensive renewal works on the Bukit Panjang LRT.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
text: In my subsequent Statement, I will mention the need, certainly my desire, our desire, of speeding up this renewal programme because, until they are renewed, the lines always have to face this risk of some sort of disruptions.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Since the Minister of Transport has built up a good momentum, the Ministerial Statement next.
